drafter.private_reasoning: The draft NDA from opposing counsel is straightforward and reasonable. The three-year protection period and twenty-four-month term are standard and acceptable from our client's perspective. However, the document lacks explicit confidentiality obligations detailing the handling and return of confidential information. Adding a clause clarifying the return or destruction of confidential information at termination will better protect our client's interests. Also, clarifying the definitions around Confidential Information to exclude publicly available or independently developed information is standard practice and should be added. No price or deal-specific terms appear in the NDA, so no mention of confidential pricing or deal terms is necessary here, which protects our confidential bottom line information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We have reviewed your initial draft of the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement. Overall, it is fair and acceptable to our client with minor suggested refinements for clarifying the scope and protection of confidential information. Please see our proposed edits and let us know if you have any questions or concerns.

edits.text: "Confidential Information" shall mean any information disclosed by one party to the other that is designated confidential or that reasonably should be understood to be confidential, excluding information that is or becomes publicly available through no fault of the receiving party, or is independently developed by the receiving party without use of the confidential information.

drafter.private_reasoning: Opposing counsel wants to extend the confidentiality protection period beyond three years and tighten the definition of confidential information. We can offer a modest extension from three to five years, which still protects our client's interests but is palatable time-wise. Regarding the definition, we can clarify that confidential information excludes information independently developed or that becomes public without breach, keeping it balanced. We should add language about return or destruction of confidential information upon termination explicitly as per the inserted text. Overall, these changes advance the deal by accommodating their concerns without risking undue extended obligations.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Dear Counsel,

We appreciate your feedback and have further refined the Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement accordingly. We propose extending the confidentiality protection period to five years to address your concerns. Additionally, we've clarified the definition of Confidential Information to explicitly exclude information independently developed or that becomes publicly available without breach, ensuring balanced protection.

We have also included provisions requiring the return or destruction of all Confidential Information upon termination or expiration of the agreement, with certification upon request.

Please review the attached redline and let us know if you have any further comments. We look forward to progressing towards mutual agreement.

Best regards,

Aldous Finch LLP
